questions.answer: These form an arithmetic sequence with $a=6$, $d=6$, $n=10$. $S_{10}=\dfrac{10}{2}(12+9(6))=5(12+54)=5(66)=330$.

sections.heading: Reading a sequence from its terms

questions.q: The bar chart shows the first five terms of a sequence.
parts: Determine whether the sequence is arithmetic or geometric, and find the common ratio or difference.
answers: Geometric — each term is double the previous one, so $r=2$.
